subject: Request: 25 skill-building tasks with coaching feedback
body:
Marcus asked me to request a list of 25 tasks to build my skills. Please assign 25 tasks and provide coaching feedback as I complete them. He asked that your tasks include guidance and evaluation on completion. I will track progress and report back after each task.

If you prefer the FI label, treat this as a request to Forge Data Lead.

Thanks,
GI
